DataTable.read_data.title: Read Data Table
DataTable.read_data.comment: Read data from data table @{read_type}, output to variable @{cell_info||row_info||column_info||area_info}

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number to read (e.g. 1, 2, 3...)

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to read (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

start_col.title: Start Column
start_col.tip: Specify the start column number (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

end_row.title: End Row
end_row.tip: End row must be >= start row; 0 or empty reads the used area

end_col.title: End Column
end_col.tip: End column must be >= start column; empty reads the used area

is_trim_spaces.title: Trim Spaces
is_trim_spaces.tip: Whether to trim leading/trailing spaces from strings when reading

is_replace_none.title: Replace Empty Values
is_replace_none.tip: Whether to replace None with empty string when reading

cell_info.title: Cell Data
cell_info.tip: Returns data from the specified cell as a string

row_info.title: Row Data
row_info.tip: Returns data from the specified row as an array

column_info.title: Column Data
column_info.tip: Returns data from the specified column as an array

area_info.title: Area Data
area_info.tip: Returns data from the specified area as a 2D array

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number to write (e.g. 1, 2, 3...)

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to write (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

data.title: Data to Write
data.tip: Data content to write. Cell requires string, row/column requires array, area requires 2D array

start_col.title: Start Column
start_col.tip: Specify the start column number (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

cell_insert_shift.title: Cell Insert Shift
cell_insert_shift.tip: How to shift cells when inserting (shift down, shift right)

row_insert_shift.title: Row Insert Position
row_insert_shift.tip: Where to insert rows (insert above, insert below)

column_insert_shift.title: Column Insert Position
column_insert_shift.tip: Where to insert columns (insert left, insert right)

append_position.title: Append Method
append_position.tip: Select how to append data (row append, column append)

DataTable.get_max_row.title: Get Used Rows in Data Table
DataTable.get_max_row.comment: Get the maximum used row number in the data table and output to @{max_row}

max_row.title: Maximum Row Number
max_row.tip: Returns the maximum row number in the data table as an integer

DataTable.get_max_column.title: Get Used Columns in Data Table
DataTable.get_max_column.comment: Get the maximum used column number in the data table and output to @{max_column}

max_column.title: Maximum Column Number
max_column.tip: Returns the maximum column number in the data table as an integer

DataTable.copy_data.title: Copy Data Table
DataTable.copy_data.comment: Copy @{copy_type} data from the data table to clipboard

copy_type.title: Copy Method
copy_type.tip: Select how to copy data (cell, row, column, area)

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number to copy (e.g. 1, 2, 3...)

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to copy (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

start_col.title: Start Column
start_col.tip: Specify the start column number (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

end_row.title: End Row
end_row.tip: End row must be >= start row; 0 or empty copies the used area

end_col.title: End Column
end_col.tip: End column must be >= start column; empty copies the used area

copied_cell.title: Copied Cell
copied_cell.tip: Returns the copied cell data as a string

copied_row.title: Copied Row
copied_row.tip: Returns the copied row data as an array

copied_column.title: Copied Column
copied_column.tip: Returns the copied column data as an array

copied_area.title: Copied Area
copied_area.tip: Returns the copied area data as a 2D array

DataTable.paste_data.title: Paste Data Table
DataTable.paste_data.comment: Paste data from clipboard to data table @{paste_type}

paste_type.title: Paste Method
paste_type.tip: Select how to paste data (cell, row, column, area)

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number to paste to (e.g. 1, 2, 3...)

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to paste to (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

start_col.title: Start Column
start_col.tip: Specify the start column number (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

delete_type.title: Delete Method
delete_type.tip: Select how to delete data (cell, row, column, area)

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number to delete (e.g. 1, 2, 3...)

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to delete (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

start_col.title: Start Column
start_col.tip: Specify the start column number (e.g. A, B, C, AB...)

end_row.title: End Row
end_row.tip: End row must be >= start row; 0 or empty deletes the used area

end_col.title: End Column
end_col.tip: End column must be >= start column; empty deletes the used area

delete_cell_move.title: Cell Shift After Deletion
delete_cell_move.tip: How to shift cells after deletion (shift left, shift up)

delete_col_move.title: Shift Left After Column Deletion
delete_col_move.tip: Movement direction after deleting a column (shift left)

delete_row_move.title: Shift Up After Row Deletion
delete_row_move.tip: Movement direction after deleting a row (shift up)

DataTable.loop_data_table.title: Loop Data Table
DataTable.loop_data_table.comment: Loop through @{loop_type} in the data table, output index to @{index}, output value to @{value}

loop_type.title: Loop Type
loop_type.tip: Select how to loop (row, column, area)

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number to loop

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to loop

start_row.title: Start Row
start_row.tip: Specify the start row of the loop area

start_col.title: Start Column
start_col.tip: Specify the start column of the loop area

end_row.title: End Row
end_row.tip: Specify the end row of the loop area

end_col.title: End Column
end_col.tip: Specify the end column of the loop area

index.title: Current Index
index.tip: Returns the index of the current iteration

value.title: Current Value
value.tip: Returns the value of the current iteration

DataTable.insert_row_column.title: Insert Row/Column in Data Table
DataTable.insert_row_column.comment: Insert @{amount} blank @{insert_type}(s) into the data table

insert_type.title: Insert Type
insert_type.tip: Select whether to insert rows or columns

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number at the insert position

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number at the insert position

row_insert_shift.title: Row Insert Position
row_insert_shift.tip: Where to insert rows (insert above, insert below)

column_insert_shift.title: Column Insert Position
column_insert_shift.tip: Where to insert columns (insert left, insert right)

DataTable.insert_formula.title: Insert Formula in Data Table
DataTable.insert_formula.comment: Insert formula @{formula} into data table cell @{col}@{row}

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number for the formula

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number for the formula

formula.title: Formula
formula.tip: Formula to insert, e.g. "=SUM(A1:A5)". Supports math, statistics, logic, text, date, and lookup formulas

DataTable.set_column_title.title: Set Column Info in Data Table
DataTable.set_column_title.comment: Set info @{title} for column @{col} in the data table

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to set

DataTable.get_column_title.title: Get Column Info in Data Table
DataTable.get_column_title.comment: Get info for column @{col} in the data table and output to @{column_title}

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to get

column_title.title: Column Info
column_title.tip: Returns the info for the specified column

DataTable.find_and_replace.title: Find and Replace in Data Table
DataTable.find_and_replace.comment: Search for @{find_value} using @{find_type} in data table@{is_replace:, and replace}

find_type.title: Find Type
find_type.tip: Select how to search: single column or entire table

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to search (e.g. A, B, C...). Used only for single column search

is_case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive
is_case_sensitive.tip: Whether to distinguish case when searching

is_replace.title: Replace
is_replace.tip: Whether to replace the found content

replace_value.title: Replace Content
replace_value.tip: The replacement content; used only when replacing

find_data_positions.title: Found Positions
find_data_positions.tip: Returns a list of positions where the content was found

DataTable.filter_data_table.title: Filter Data Table
DataTable.filter_data_table.comment: Filter data table based on @{filter_type} conditions

filter_type.title: Filter Type
filter_type.tip: Select filter type (column filter, row filter, table filter)

row.title: Row Number
row.tip: Specify the row number to filter

col.title: Column Number
col.tip: Specify the column number to filter

is_case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive
is_case_sensitive.tip: Whether to distinguish case when filtering

is_save_filtered.title: Save Filter Result
is_save_filtered.tip: Whether to save the filter result

DataTable.import_data_table_from_file.title: Import Data from File to Data Table
DataTable.import_data_table_from_file.comment: Import data from file @{import_file_path} into the data table

import_file_path.title: Import File Path
import_file_path.tip: File path of the data to import

sheet_name.title: Sheet Name
sheet_name.tip: Name of the sheet to import; defaults to the active sheet

export_dest_path.title: Export Destination Path
export_dest_path.tip: Path where the exported file will be saved

export_file_type.title: Export File Type
export_file_type.tip: Select the file type to export

is_overwrite.title: Overwrite Existing File
is_overwrite.tip: Whether to overwrite an existing file with the same name at the destination

export_file_path.title: Export File Path
export_file_path.tip: Returns the full path of the exported file
